INCOMPLETE
  ✗ cron_runner live run exit 0, 80 cycles, autonomy 80/80, lock-rate 0, peak RSS measured < 300MB: Partial evidence only. PROVEN from the raw run log cron_logs/run_e2e_t20261006_1508.jsonl (197 rows, mtime Oct 6 10:11): 80 distinct cycle records (cycles 1..80, none missing); preflight row {"event":"preflight","component":"jev","status":"pass","ok":true}; run_autonomy row decisions_total=80, jev_answered=80, autonomy_ratio=1.0, escalated=12, jev_transport_failures=0, degraded=false; all 80 cycle rows carry jev_ok=true/jev_answered=true -> 80 cycles and autonomy 80/80 CONFIRMED. screenshots/run_e2e_t20261006_1508/ holds 64 PNGs step_0001..step_0080 (mtime 10:10-10:11), corroborating a real 80-cycle execution. NOT PROVEN: (a) exit 0 — no captured exit code exists anywhere; the board row .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl#E2E-001 has "exit_code": null, and there is no stdout log, no RUN_EXIT= line and no shell wrapper for this run (contrast /var/tmp/aipp_e2e_t282.sh + aipp_e2e_t282_run.log which ends "RUN_EXIT=0"); (b) lock-rate 0 — the counter is emitted ONLY on the runner's final stdout summary line (cron_runner.py:3405 '| lock-rate: {lock_warn_cycles}/{total_cycles} cycles with direction-lock warnings', counter incremented at cron_runner.py:6872 from _cycle_dir_lock_warned set at cron_runner.py:6439); no stdout log exists for e2e_t20261006_1508 and the JSONL carries no lock field, so 0/80 is unverifiable (prior windows did capture it: cron_logs/e2e001_20261003_t275_stdout.log:509 and e2e001_20261002_t270_stdout.log:420 both show 'lock-rate: 0/80 cycles with direction-lock warnings (0%)'); (c) peak RSS measured < 300MB — no measurement artifact at all for this run (no *_rss.txt / ps sample file; contrast cron_logs/e2e001_20261003_t275_evidence.txt 'RUN_EXIT=0 PEAK_RSS_KB=92480 SAMPLES=5' and /var/tmp/aipp_e2e_t282_rss.txt). The only support for exit 0 / lock-rate 0 / RSS 91MB is prose in board bookkeeping (.coding-hermes/board/events.jsonl:530 tick_number 285 and the E2E-001 tasks.jsonl worker_summary), which is not captured command output. The repo already owns a fail-closed instrument that would have produced exactly this evidence — scripts/evaluate_e2e_l2.py (commit 5deb8f0) launches cron_runner.py --cycles 80 under RLIMIT_AS=4GiB, records process_exit_code (line 708) and peak RSS via resource.getrusage(RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss (line 656) into artifacts/e2e/<run-id>/manifest.json — but it was not used for this run and artifacts/e2e/ does not exist. Fresh test runs: `./.venv/bin/pytest tests/test_e2e_l2_acceptance.py -q` -> exit 0, '12 passed in 0.45s'; `./.venv/bin/pytest tests/test_cron_runner_metrics.py tests/test_autonomy_counters.py -q` -> exit 0, '73 passed in 0.73s'; `-k lock` -> '4 passed, 57 deselected' (formatting-only). No test verifies the tick-285 run's exit code, lock-rate or RSS.
The tick-285 fixture run genuinely executed 80 cycles with autonomy 80/80 (proven from cron_logs/run_e2e_t20261006_1508.jsonl), but exit 0, lock-rate 0 and measured peak RSS < 300MB are asserted only in board bookkeeping with no captured exit code, stdout summary line, or RSS sample artifact, so the criterion is not met.
